test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1): Morning Practice - Day 1
subject: general
question: Y can complete a work in 20 days and Z can complete the same work in 10 days. If both work together, what percentage of the total work will be completed in 3 days?
solution:
**Given:**

Y can complete a work in 20 days.

Z can complete the same work in 10 days.

The amount of work done together in 3 days is needed.

**Concept used:**

Work done is inversely proportional to the time taken. When two people work together, their combined rate of work is the sum of their individual rates.

**Calculation:**

Work done by Y in a day = 1/20

Work done by Z in a day = 1/10

Combined work done in a day = (1/20) + (1/10) = 0.15 

Work done in 3 days = 0.15 × 3 = 0.45

Convert this to percentage = 0.45 × 100% = 45%

**∴ Y and Z together will complete 45% of the work in 3 days.**
